Card machine tricks and ATM cloning
Fake gifts in Pelourinho and beach theft
Unlicensed tour operators and street money changers
Every guide has a page of safety tips
legenda:
8 tourist traps in Brazil, and how to dodge them:
• Phone snatching: check maps inside a shop
• Fake taxis: app rides or official counters only
• Card machines: check the amount before you tap
• ATM cloning: use ATMs inside banks or malls
• "Free" gifts in Pelourinho: say no and keep walking
• Beach theft: never leave bags alone
• Unlicensed tours: look for the ICMBio badge in Lençóis
• Street money changers: use a bank or your card
Share this with whoever is traveling with you.

🇪🇸 8 trampas para turistas en Brasil: robo de celulares, taxis falsos, trucos con la máquina de tarjeta, clonación en cajeros, "regalos" en Pelourinho, robos en la playa, guías sin licencia y cambistas en la calle. Comparte con quien viaja contigo.
